# Stigmergic_RL

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A reinforcement learning paradigm where agents coordinate indirectly through environmental modifications (stigmergy) rather than direct communication. Enables scalable, decentralized swarm control in network topologies without centralized coordination, relevant for adaptive in-network decision-making.
